satellites.title: The Fifth Aggregate
satellites.evidence: The Heart Sutra lists consciousness (識) among five aggregates. This is a distinct use from the Abhidharmakośa discussion of 心意識.

satellites.title: Consciousness in the Five Aggregates
satellites.evidence: 識 is used for consciousness in the five aggregates. The Sanskrit term vijñāna belongs to this technical context, not to every possible reading of the English word consciousness.
satellites.caveat: A proposed equivalence awaiting verification in an aligned Sanskrit–Chinese source; citation assignment is not verification.
gaps: Check the historical source translation as well as both dictionary senses.

satellites.title: The Storehouse Consciousness
satellites.evidence: Yogācāra counts eight consciousnesses: six of the senses, then manas, transcribed 末那, then the ālaya-vijñāna, 阿賴耶識. The Cheng weishi lun names the first transformation 初阿賴耶識, and makes 末那 the support on which the sixth, 意識, turns.
satellites.caveat: A hybrid rendering: 阿賴耶 keeps ālaya by sound, while 識 translates vijñāna.
